selection_selector_invalid: Invalid selector: '{selector}' (in {where}). Use <type>:<id>, with the type among: {kinds}.
selection_selector_unmatched: The selector '{selector}' matches nothing in this project (in {where}).
selection_rule_unsupported: The selector '{selector}' was refused as unsupported: the tool '{tool}' does not expose that rule to be switched off (in {where}).
selection_unmatched_fix: Check the name (jgates config resolve --explain lists the checks) or remove the selector.
selection_locked_violation: Cannot switch off the locked requirement '{lock}': {reason}. The switch-off came from '{selector}' in {by}.
selection_locked_fix: Remove the switch-off, or unlock the requirement in policy.yml (locked: true) with the approval of whoever governs the policy.
